about-me.title: About Me
about-me.description: I am a junior front-end developer and built my software development skills through intensive training at the Developer Academy. Getting started in the IT world was a real challenge for me, as I started with no prior knowledge—but that's exactly what sparked my ambition. Step by step, I realized that this was exactly what I wanted to do. My interest in IT began earlier, when I worked on a software project and was in close contact with developers. Back then, I translated requirements from the user's perspective – today, I write the code myself. This change of perspective still inspires me today. For me, programming is the perfect mix of creativity and structure. I can design solutions, try things out, and work logically and cleanly at the same time. It motivates me incredibly when an idea gradually turns into a functioning application. My strengths include perseverance, creativity, and teamwork. I enjoy working with others and look forward to developing myself professionally and personally. My goal is to develop myself as a developer in the long term and actively contribute to the success of the team.
